lines.4: 「Yes. I am counting on you again today.」
lines.5: 「You really are determined. You looked so pale yesterday.」
lines.6: 「If I run because I am weak at something, I set a poor example for you, my younger brother, and above all for myself.」
lines.7: 「That said, relying on you like this every night is not ideal.」

lines.9: 「I will explore everything else on my own.」

lines.32: 「I see. This is much easier to understand when you show me directly.」

lines.35: The Princess was unfair up close, but Otome could make me blush too.

lines.39: 「Then choose the option that says Shut Down...」
lines.42: Her hand had grown sweaty after I held it so long.
lines.43: 「I-it took quite a while, but do you understand after repeating it?」
lines.45: 「Then try it alone from the beginning.」
lines.49: 「...Otome, you don't need the battle cries.」

lines.51: 「...True. No one in the council shouts while doing it.」

lines.61: 「No. I have a good younger brother.」

lines.87: 「A-as expected of you, Otome. I honestly thought machines were your weakness, but I stand corrected.」

lines.93: She did not even notice the Princess was mocking her.
lines.94: She was so straightforward and pure.
lines.95: To someone twisted like me, it was dazzling.

lines.99: 「... (As an adult, I decline to comment.)」
lines.100: 「In return, I will look after you even more closely from now on.」
